decisive_pair.contrast: High-Altitude Pulmonary Edema (HAPE) is more likely due to the combination of high altitude, snow burial, and respiratory symptoms

response.rationale: The combination of high altitude, snow burial, and respiratory symptoms, including cyanosis, low oxygen saturation, and bilateral rales and crackles, make High-Altitude Pulmonary Edema (HAPE) the most likely diagnosis
